assumptions: Exact66-source compiler input, materialized deployed runtimes and immutable bindings must match current canonical public observation.
Only current FactoryV2/TokenV2/CurveV1, immutable original ledgers/engine/guard and pinned externalPoolManager/PositionManager/Permit2 are accepted.
Current V1→V2 uses the immutable factory-pinned deployer. No arbitrary future template, optional treasury/NFT/Reclaim/Seaport functionality is accepted.
Production publication enables direct third-party creation and permissionless trading/graduation regardless of website OFF flags; owner approval must acknowledge this.
Current authority, actual notice/expiry, L2canonicality, physical wallet/device acceptance and off-device operations recovery remain independently verified gates. L1finality is not asserted.

findings.materialLossPathMeaning: No demonstrated or plausible unresolved material loss path identified within the exact currently accepted immutable graph; not a formal absence theorem.
findings.argument: Uncontrolled interleaving would need to divert funding or compensate a flagged engine/shared-manager baseline. Canonical TokenV2 has exact call-free transfers; real Permit2 moves only the bounded amount; engine encodes one MINT_POSITION and SETTLE_PAIR; only beforeInitialize hook is enabled and it has no outgoing call; NFT mint uses non-safe _mint. The manager unlock is exclusive and all token/native debits, finite approvals, PoolKey, owner, ticks, liquidity and subscription are reconciled. Current shared storage cannot schedule an extra transaction inside this synchronous graph.

findings.materialLossPathMeaning: No demonstrated or plausible unresolved material loss path identified within the exact currently accepted immutable graph; not a formal absence theorem.
findings.argument: One fixed zero-liquidity INCREASE_LIQUIDITY plus TAKE_PAIR pays exact original-position earnings to its immutable ledger. The original NFT has no approvals, engine ERC1271 or subscriber; the only hook is beforeInitialize. PoolManager unlock excludes interleaved manager sessions. Native ledger receive only accepts manager and calls nobody; TokenV2 transfer has no callback. Exact original custody/liquidity/growth and both ledger increments precede credit. Beneficiary claims are separate guarded payments; failed claims/record revert. Donations stay outside entitlements.

Factory and Registry routes are hidden under handoff, then published after authority/state reconciliation.

findings.materialLossPathMeaning: No demonstrated or plausible unresolved material loss path identified within the exact currently accepted immutable graph; not a formal absence theorem.
